projectDetails.title: 别猜了，就是一本小说
projectDetails.subtitle: 《红楼梦》评论集书籍设计
projectDetails.description: 这是一本《红楼梦》评论集，作者以细腻的笔触带领读者破解红楼文本的隐藏密码。作者理解的红楼，是说感情、说性灵、说处世，《红楼梦》的终点不是空，爱与美才是其永恒的命题。设计从文本内容入手，对文字意象进行高度凝炼，在每篇章节前放置不同层次的现代图形，形成高辨识度的美学语言，在文本之外留给读者更多想象空间。书籍整体定位为当代典雅，色彩提炼自孙温绘制《红楼梦》用色，篇章过渡页提炼人物服饰与楼阁纹样，在提高明度与饱和度的同时加入冷调灰进行对比调和，让读者领略大观园的遍地芳华。
projectDetails.descriptionEn: This is a collection of essays on Dream of the Red Chamber. With delicate and perceptive writing, the author guides readers to decode hidden meanings in the original text. In this interpretation, the novel speaks of emotion, sensibility, and the art of living; its destination is not emptiness, but the enduring themes of love and beauty. The design begins from the text itself, distilling literary imagery into layered contemporary graphics placed before each chapter to form a recognizable visual language while leaving room for imagination. The overall direction is contemporary elegance: the color system is drawn from Sun Wen's Qing-dynasty illustrations, then rebalanced with brighter tones and cool grays, while costume and architectural motifs are simplified and abstracted for chapter transitions.
content: 项目名称：《别猜了，就是一本小说》
CL：Shaanxi Normal University Press / AD：Jin Li / D：ZhiWei Sun
contentEn: Project: Stop Guessing — It's Just a Novel
CL: Shaanxi Normal University Press / AD: Jin Li / D: ZhiWei Sun

projectDetails.title: 生长的语法
projectDetails.subtitle: 综合设计展
projectDetails.description: 2025年10月，2cubes 二立方与长沙 233 艺术社区合作，策划当代艺术设计综合展 《生长的语法 The Grammar of Growth》。展览汇集了 5 位海归艺术家的 7 件作品，媒介涵盖装置、影像、档案、书籍与平面设计等，试图从不同维度展开对“生长”这一命题的观察与表达。二立方参与并完成了本次展览的展陈策划、主视觉设计及宣发执行。基于 233 老厂房改造空间的原始气质，2³ 成员就地取材，以理性的空间判断与审美节奏，快速构建出一个兼具艺术深度、互动体验与社区氛围的展览现场。
projectDetails.descriptionEn: In October 2025, 2cubes collaborated with Changsha 233 Art Community to curate a contemporary art and design integrated exhibition, "The Grammar of Growth". The exhibition brought together 7 works by 5 artists returned from abroad, spanning installations, moving images, archives, books, and graphic design, observing and expressing the theme of "Growth" from diverse dimensions. 2cubes participated in and completed the exhibition display curation, main visual design, and publicity execution. Based on the raw texture of the renovated spaces of the 233 old factory building, 2³ members utilized local resources and fast spatial judgment to quickly build a exhibition scene that balances art depth, interactive experience, and community atmosphere.
content: 项目名称：《生长的语法》（The Grammar of Growth）
CL：233艺术社区 / AD：贺论一/刘思均 / CD：贺论一 / D：贺论一/刘思均
contentEn: CL: 233 Art Community / AD: Lunyi He / Sijun Liu / CD: Lunyi He / D: Lunyi He / Sijun Liu

projectDetails.title: 第二届小草艺术节
projectDetails.subtitle: 碟蝶不休主视觉及招募海报
projectDetails.description: 2cubes为长沙第二届小草艺术节·碟蝶不休设计了主视觉及招募海报。飞碟营地曾是一座旧军工厂，承载着一代人的集体记忆与青春热血；如今，它成为新艺术家自由表达的创作现场。 两种时代精神在此交汇碰撞，“不休”不止。「碟」：源自飞碟营地，喻指军工厂冷硬的精密零件，也隐喻那个封闭而未知的过去时代。「蝶」：象征艺术与蜕变，如蝴蝶破茧，为这片工业遗址带来柔软而坚韧的新生命。
projectDetails.descriptionEn: 2cubes designed the key visual and recruitment posters for the 2nd Little Grass Art Festival - Never Ending in Changsha. UFO Camp was once an old military factory, carrying the collective memory and passion of a generation; today, it has become a creative field for new artists to express freely. Two spirits of different eras converge and collide here, never ending. 'UFO/Plate': originating from the UFO Camp, it represents the cold, precise parts of the military factory, and also metaphors the closed and unknown past. 'Butterfly': symbolizing art and metamorphosis, like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon, bringing soft yet resilient new life to this industrial heritage.
content: 项目名称：第二届小草艺术节·碟蝶不休
CL：233艺术社区/华驿-飞碟营地 / AD：贺论一 / CD：贺论一 / D：贺论一/孙智威
contentEn: Project: The 2nd Little Grass Art Festival
CL: 233 Art Community / Huayi-UFO Camp / AD: Lunyi He / CD: Lunyi He / D: Lunyi He / Zhiwei Sun
